candidateIdentity: Local ADS-003 candidate derived from the committed ADS-002 base; the coherent slice commit identity follows final verification and commit readback.
postconditions: Every hosted-proof environment value is decoded once through Effect Config and owning Schemas before Chromium acquisition.
URL, stage/PR identity, digests, provider identities, evidence paths, retry count and retry delay fail closed on missing, empty, malformed, partial, unsafe or out-of-range values.
Preview requires matching pr-N and positive PR number; Production and rollback require prod with no PR number.
One focused Playwright host adapter remains at the host edge while Effect.tryPromise adapts launch and proof execution.
Effect Scope and acquireRelease close Chromium after success, expected failure and interruption.
Configuration, execution and evidence errors expose only fixed safe meaning and do not retain input values, URLs, raw environment content or local absolute paths.
The workflow YAML owns the exact retry count and delay and the hosted command retains one BunRuntime.runMain boundary.

documentationImpact.reason: These owners explain the strict input contract, scoped browser lifetime, workflow-owned numeric limits, local proof ceiling, task state and validation evidence.
The local workerd child-process owner, one-resource native graph, exact-stage owner, provider inventory and historical evidence remain unchanged.

The slice changes a private hosted-proof command, private tests, workflow input ownership and maintainer documentation only; no version-managed package, public API, SDK export or public content contract changes.

limitations: The provider-free tests use a narrow fake browser handle; they prove configuration order and finalizer behaviour, not Chromium or Playwright hosted behaviour.
The browser close finalizer treats a close failure as a defect rather than converting it to expected success.
Static and local repository proof does not establish a hosted GitHub run, Cloudflare state or public application behaviour.
nonClaims: No GitHub workflow was dispatched and no Cloudflare bootstrap, plan, deploy, rollback, destroy or provider readback was performed for ADS-003.
No Production, hosted application, DNS, custom-domain, package publication, release or public availability claim follows from this slice.
